criteria.requirement: Demonstrate or correctly explain the mixed-content order limitation and distinguish data-oriented mappings from lexical XML editing. Do not claim byte-perfect preservation, silently strip meaningful mixed text, or label an unpromised guarantee a defect requiring a patch.
Use actual supplied materials and pinned source, respect authorization and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
